reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Nevada
    Focus year: 2021

    Question:
    "Is the term 'Warrant for removal' used to refer to the order from the court
     to the authorities to remove a tenant?"
*/

% -----------------------
% Scenario (facts)
% -----------------------

scenario_state(nevada).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The term the user is asking about.
scenario_term_in_question(warrant_for_removal).

% The concept the user describes: "the order from the court to the authorities to remove a tenant".
scenario_described_concept(court_order_directing_authority_to_remove_tenant).

% The scenario statement succeeds when the question context is fully present.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(nevada),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_term_in_question(warrant_for_removal),
    scenario_described_concept(court_order_directing_authority_to_remove_tenant).

% -----------------------
% Statute translations (deterministic predicates)
% -----------------------

/*
  NV Rev Stat  40.253 (2021)
  - Court may issue a "summary order for removal of the tenant" and it directs
    the sheriff/constable to post the order and remove the tenant within certain times.
*/
statute_nv_40_253_term_used(summary_order_for_removal_of_tenant).  % phrase used in statute

statute_nv_40_253_concept(summary_order_for_removal_of_tenant,
                          court_order_directing_authority_to_remove_tenant).

/*
  NV Rev Stat  40.280 (2021)
  - Refers to "an order for removal of a tenant" (issued pursuant to NRS 40.253 or 40.254),
    "a writ of restitution", and other orders.
*/
statute_nv_40_280_term_used(order_for_removal_of_tenant).          % phrase used in statute
statute_nv_40_280_term_used(writ_of_restitution).                 % phrase used in statute

statute_nv_40_280_concept(order_for_removal_of_tenant,
                          court_order_directing_authority_to_remove_tenant).
statute_nv_40_280_concept(writ_of_restitution,
                          court_order_directing_authority_to_restore_possession).

% Aggregate: terms expressly used by the relevant 2021 Nevada statutes provided.
statute_term_used_in_provided_text(Term) :-
    (   statute_nv_40_253_term_used(Term)
    ->  !
    ;   statute_nv_40_280_term_used(Term)
    ).

% Aggregate: whether a given statute-used term corresponds to the described concept.
statute_term_matches_concept(Term, Concept) :-
    (   statute_nv_40_253_concept(Term, Concept)
    ->  !
    ;   statute_nv_40_280_concept(Term, Concept)
    ).

% -----------------------
% Reasoning helpers
% -----------------------

% The question asks whether the specific term is used (in the provided statutes)
% to refer to the described concept.
term_used_to_refer_to_concept_in_statutes(Term, Concept) :-
    statute_term_used_in_provided_text(Term),
    statute_term_matches_concept(Term, Concept).

% -----------------------
% Final answer (deterministic)
% -----------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_term_in_question(Term),
    scenario_described_concept(Concept),
    term_used_to_refer_to_concept_in_statutes(Term, Concept),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% -----------------------
% Main entrypoint
% -----------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the term 'Warrant for removal' used to refer to the order from the court to the authorities to remove a tenant?
